system.name: UniPixel
system.one_liner: A large multi-modal model that reads visual prompts (points, boxes, masks) and answers with masks, unifying referring and segmentation for images and videos.

content.variant_note: nine pastel task cards in rows of three, three, two and one; the last wide gradient card is the novel combined task PixelQA
content.argues: One model flexibly handles referring, reasoning and interactive segmentation, motion-grounded reasoning and referred description and QA, and also the new PixelQA that joins referring, segmentation and QA in video.
content.subject: Nine task cards, each with a prompt or answer and a row of photos or video frames with coloured masks.

elements.name: Referring Expression Segmentation (RES)
elements.role: task card: segment the object a sentence refers to
elements.drawn_as: light-blue card, two prompt boxes and two photos with red and magenta masks

elements.name: Reasoning Segmentation (ReasonSeg)
elements.role: task card: segment the region that answers an implicit question
elements.drawn_as: peach card, two prompt boxes and two photos with orange and purple masks

elements.name: Interactive Segmentation (IS)
elements.role: task card: segment and track a marked region given as image or video plus click, box or scribble
elements.drawn_as: light-green card, prompt Please segment and track the marked <region>., a row of five line-art glyphs, a photo with a dashed box and click, a >> sign and the masked photo

elements.name: Referring Video Object Segmentation (RVOS)
elements.role: task card: track the object a sentence refers to in a video
elements.drawn_as: light-yellow card, one long prompt box and three frames with a pink mask on a rabbit

elements.name: Reasoning Video Object Segmentation (ReVOS)
elements.role: task card: answer a question about a video with masks
elements.drawn_as: lavender card, prompt Where are the utensils used for drinking? Answer with masks. and two frames with green masks on glasses

elements.name: Motion-Grounded Video Reasoning
elements.role: task card: answer a question about motion with a text answer and mask
elements.drawn_as: pink card, solid Q box and dashed A box, two basketball frames with orange motion arrows and mask

elements.name: Referred Video Description
elements.role: task card: describe the object marked by <region>
elements.drawn_as: violet card, Q box, long dashed A box and three frames with a blue mask on a police officer

elements.name: Referred Video Question-Answering
elements.role: task card: answer a question about a marked object
elements.drawn_as: light-cyan card, Q box with a green <region> token, dashed A box and three frames with a green mask on a breakdancer

elements.name: Pixel-Level Video Question Answering (PixelQA)
elements.role: the new combined task: Joint Referring + Segmentation + QA in Videos

lessons.what_to_learn: Show a generalist model as a grid of pastel task cards that follow one grammar (bold title, rounded prompt with its key word coloured like the mask, a row of frames), and end with a wide gradient card for the combined task that reuses the visual prompts and numbered colour badges.
lessons.suits: multi-task vision or video models whose point is breadth plus one new combined task, with real frames and masks for every task.

evidence: UniPixel flexibly supports a large variety of fine-grained image and video understanding tasks
given a video2, a question, and optionally a visual prompt
It can also handle a novel PixelQA task that jointly requires object-centric referring, segmentation, and question answering in videos.

summary: UniPixel is a large multi-modal model that takes points, boxes and masks as visual prompts and answers with masks, so one model covers many pixel-level tasks. Figure 1 is a gallery of nine pastel rounded cards in rows of three, three, two and one. Each card has a bold task title, a white rounded prompt (solid outline) or answer (dashed outline) with the key word coloured like its mask, and a row of rounded photos or video frames with translucent masks: referring, reasoning and interactive segmentation, video object segmentation, motion-grounded reasoning, referred description and QA. The wide gradient PixelQA card at the bottom joins referring, segmentation and QA, with visual-prompt glyphs, numbered badges and a >> to masked frames.
summary_zh: UniPixel 以点、框、掩码为视觉提示并输出掩码回答，统一覆盖多种像素级任务。图 1 是九张淡色圆角任务卡的画廊：每张含标题、关键词与掩码同色的提示框和一排带掩码的图像或视频帧，底部渐变宽卡 PixelQA 联合指代、分割与问答。
notes: Prior labels kept in order (contribution-mosaic as capability cards, scope-overview as an example gallery).
